offending_extra_words: Customer's payment obligations are not damages and are not limited by this Section.
reasons: Cap edit in 21.1 is a precise, minimal re-basing: it replaces the narrow first-Order-Form/defined-"Fees" basis with the exact preferred greater-of formulation (lowercase fee basis, claim anchor, USD 1,000,000 floor).
All preferred carve-outs, mutuality and the mutual indirect-damages exclusion were already present in 21.2-21.3 and were correctly left untouched.

The second operation is not needed to complete the preferred level and moves against our client: the original wording ("obligation to pay undisputed Fees for conforming Services") already carved Customer payment duties out of the cap while preserving the "undisputed" and "conforming Services" qualifiers. Broadening it to all "payment obligations" strips customer-favourable limits, so minimality fails on this edit.

Recommended fix: drop operation 2 and retain the original 21.3 carve-back sentence; the preferred payment-obligations element is substantively satisfied by it, and any residual gap is a rationale note rather than a redline.
